name: ssim_train_01
description: SSIM/reference acquisition with defined reference type

geometry.depth_reference: Front of lens at x=100 mm, measured straight forward

focus: Fixed lens focus and camera orientation
reference_method: Use the image captured at the 100 mm rail position as the single-view comparison reference. During processing, align the refocused images to this reference using the same image crop, resolution and brightness scaling. This is a proxy reference, not independent ground truth.
protocol_notes: A captured reference is NOT automatically optical ground truth; agree on reference/registration with processing owners.
